verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Amph. 803: perge porrō dīcere; Mart. 14.163.1: lūdere pergis?; Traupman 99: perge porrō, go on!; Traupman 33; Traupman 322
